chunks: The Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, said:

I was given five things that no one before me was given: the earth was made for me a masjid and a means of taharah, I was aided by fear, spoils were made lawful for me, I was given comprehensive words, and I was given intercession.

key_terms.اَلشَّفَاعَةَ: Intercession granted to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.اَلْأَرْضُ: The earth, made a place for salat
key_terms.بِالرُّعْبِ: Through fear cast into the enemies
key_terms.جَوَامِعَ اَلْكَلِمِ: Comprehensive, concise speech containing abundant meaning
key_terms.خَمْسًا: Five special distinctions mentioned in the hadith
key_terms.مَسْجِدًا: A place of prayer or prostration

ai.seo_question: What are the five special things given to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم that were not given to those before him?
ai.summary: This hadith states five distinctions granted to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم. It highlights rulings related to salat and taharah, the special divine support given to him, and his unique gifts of eloquence and shafa'ah.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "I was given five things that no one was given before me: The entire earth was made a place of prayer and a means of purification for me, I was aided with fear (cast into the hearts of my enemies), war booty was made lawful for me, I was given concise speech (Jawaami' al-Kalim), and I was granted intercession."
